title: LocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\iota:\mathcal I\to\mathcal O$ be an ideal subsheaf represented as in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-ideal-generators], and use slice derived restriction [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. An object $E\in D(\mathcal O)$ is locally derived $\mathcal I$-complete if for every object $U$ and every section $f\in\mathcal I(U)$ one has $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal O_U[1/f],E|_U)=0$. Localization is [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization], and derived internal Hom is [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. There is no boundedness condition on $E$.
